imbalance_handling.policy: balanced training loss using training labels only
imbalance_handling.accuracy_role: descriptive only; never the primary selection metric

loss_and_threshold.validation_log_loss_sample_weight: apply the training-derived class weight corresponding to each validation label; normalize by the sum of validation sample weights as implemented by the metric
loss_and_threshold.threshold_rule: fixed default threshold; no validation optimization and no test optimization

aggregation.design_level_classification: for each design, aggregate predicted breach probability as max over its five realization probabilities and aggregate observed label as max over its five realization labels; report separately from run-level selection
aggregation.specificity_definition: TN / (TN + FP), explicitly reported as class-0 recall

uncertainty.undefined_metric_rule: If a resample lacks a required class, record NaN for that replicate and report the valid-replicate count; never manufacture a class.
uncertainty.limited_negative_warning: Validation contains only two negative runs. Class-0 recall, specificity, ROC-AUC, and any metric requiring negative support have high sampling uncertainty and may be undefined in design bootstrap replicates; this limitation must appear in every validation report.

test_reporting: Apply the frozen threshold and report all listed metrics once; test metrics cannot trigger a new threshold, model, or preprocessing decision.
